name: pentatonic
description: This directory contains the technical specifications and implementation plans for the Pentatonic Synth project.

scripts.build: tsc && npm run download-models && vite build
scripts.download-models: mkdir -p public/mediapipe/wasm public/mediapipe/models && cp node_modules/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/wasm/* public/mediapipe/wasm/ && curl -L -o public/mediapipe/models/hand_landmarker.task https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task
